description: Discover baby names by gender and origin — Pakistani, Arabic, Western, Indian or Turkish — with meanings, random picks and tap-to-copy.

faqs.a: From a built-in list of 300 hand-picked names (30 boys' and 30 girls' names per origin) with commonly accepted meanings.
faqs.q: Where do the names and meanings come from?

faqs.a: Yes — choose “Any” as the gender and you'll get a random mix from both lists of the selected origin.
faqs.q: Can I mix boys' and girls' names?

faqs.a: Meanings reflect the most commonly cited ones, but names can have multiple interpretations across cultures — treat them as a guide.

howto: Choose Boy, Girl, or Any for the gender.
Pick an origin: Pakistani, Arabic, Western, Indian or Turkish.
Select how many names you'd like to see, then click “Generate Names”.
Tap any name card to copy it to your clipboard.
title: Baby Name Generator
